name: phase224-groq-llama31-8b-content-completeness-rerun
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. Top-level keys: schema_version, id, mission_revision_id, operation_id, base_commit_id, read_set, preconditions, changes, expected_delta, validator_ids, provenance, idempotency_key. Adversarial note: legacy examples may encode read_set as "manifest", preconditions as "none", expected_delta as ["one observation"], schema_version as "1", or changes as one object; all of those legacy encodings are INVALID and MUST NOT be copied. Produce canonical types instead: schema_version is number 1; read_set is ["manifest"]; preconditions is []; expected_delta is "one observation"; validator_ids is ["schema"]; changes is an array containing exactly one object with kind "ADD", entity_type "observation", entity_id "observation_runtime_gate", payload_ref "artifact_runtime_gate". id, mission_revision_id, operation_id, base_commit_id, provenance, and idempotency_key are JSON strings. No wrapper, Markdown, comments, or explanation.
